scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc --noEmit --incremental false && vite build
scripts.test: sh -c 'maxWorkers=4; helper=../../../scripts/lib/load-aware-workers.sh; if [ -r "$helper" ]; then . "$helper"; computed=$(load_aware_workers 4 2>/dev/null) || computed=; case "$computed" in ""|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) maxWorkers=$computed ;; esac; fi; vitest run --maxWorkers="$maxWorkers" --exclude "scripts/*.test.mjs" "$@" && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs' --
scripts.test:coverage: sh -c 'maxWorkers=4; helper=../../../scripts/lib/load-aware-workers.sh; if [ -r "$helper" ]; then . "$helper"; computed=$(load_aware_workers 4 2>/dev/null) || computed=; case "$computed" in ""|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) maxWorkers=$computed ;; esac; fi; vitest run --coverage --maxWorkers="$maxWorkers" --exclude "scripts/*.test.mjs" "$@"' --
